test_title: PYST 5: Selection Post (Higher Secondary Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:

P: Rahul

Q: completed

R: in time

S: his assignment
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **PQSR**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "Rahul," which is correctly indicated by **part (P).**
 
• Following the subject, "completed his assignment" **(PQ)** continues the logical sequence, making it clear what Rahul did.
 
• **The next part,** "in time," starts the explanation about when the assignment was completed, which is indicated by (SR).
 
• **The correct sequence is:** *Rahul completed his assignment in time.*

Therefore, the correct answer is **PQSR.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (SRPQ):** This option starts with "his assignment in time Rahul completed," which results in a grammatically incorrect sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (SRQP):** This option starts with "his assignment in time completed Rahul," which makes the sentence unclear and grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4 (SQPR):** This option starts with "his assignment Rahul in time completed," which distorts the logical flow of the sentence.
